items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 86:1
items.html: There are three phases in the kings that were broken: lights, sparks, and vessels. And at the time of correction, the vessels of the Mochin, which are the three hollows in the bone of the Galgalta, were clarified from the vessels of the kings; and the membranes of the Mochin were clarified from the sparks of the kings; and from their lights that remained in Atzilut, the refined flesh called Motin was made. Hence the membranes are phases of judgment and phases of the names of Elokim, since they come from the sparks of BYA. But the Mochin are phases of the names of HaVaYaH, which are mercy, since they come from the lights that never went out below the phases of Atzilut. Also, from the sparks, the phase of Nefesh was made for the external organs of the Partzuf, and from the lights, the phase of Nefesh was made for the internal organs of the Partzuf. And all this also applies in pregnancy and nursing. (Item 97).
